title: Beef & Barley Soup
description: A hearty soup of tender beef, pearl barley and root vegetables in a rich broth.
steps: Brown the beef, then set aside.
Sauté the onion, carrot and celery, then return the beef with the broth, barley and herbs.
Simmer 1-1.5 hours until the beef and barley are tender.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food soup recipe collection

notes: Barley thickens the soup naturally as it cooks — no need for flour or cream.
